maintenance_led.reason: Roofing, the largest segment, is mostly reroofing and storm replacement of existing roofs, sold as shingles through distributors to contractors.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are homeowners, roofing contractors, builders and distributors, all paying privately for roofing, insulation and doors.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own branded roofing, insulation and doors, with only occasional acquisitions such as the Masonite doors deal.

mission_critical.reason: Shingles and insulation are branded building products that contractors can swap for competitors' without major re-qualification or downtime.

notes: Replacement share of roofing revenue comes from my own knowledge, not the website text.
